function: Joint learned design of AP mode selection, user association, precoding and echo fusion for multi-target position and velocity estimation in cell-free ISAC (p. 1)
system: Cell-free ISAC, OFDM at 24 GHz, 120 MHz: 14 Tx-APs and 2 Rx-APs with 8-antenna ULAs, 16 single-antenna users, 3 targets; no RIS (p. 12)
method: Heterogeneous graph attention networks (dynamic GAT with 3D-CNN estimator; lightweight mirror-GAT); offline training with a ground-truth MSE loss plus rate-constraint penalty, 3D-CNN pre-trained first (p. 8)
data_channel: Simulated dataset of 12,000 samples (positions, velocities, CSI) from own system model, path-loss exponent 2.1-3.8; Sionna-RT ray tracing only for one robustness test (pp. 12, 14)
test_conditions: Default setting (8 antennas, 16 OFDM symbols, 50 dBm); tests vary antennas, symbols (stated different from training), power, APs, users, targets, imperfect CSI, Sionna-RT (pp. 12-15)
baselines: Heuristic+GAT, Random+GAT, MMSE+CNN [20] (learned), ZF+FFT [39], two-stage ML-based refinement [40] (pp. 12-13)
metrics: Position RMSE, velocity RMSE, achievable sum-rate, backhaul signaling overhead, model parameters, execution time (pp. 4, 9, 15)
complexity: Number of model parameters (millions) and average execution time (ms) versus antennas, Fig. 13; backhaul signaling counted in double-precision values (pp. 9, 15)
q1_support: p. 12: "the path-loss exponent is uniformly distributed between 2.1 and 3.8" (own simulation); p. 14: "we utilize the ray-tracing-based NVIDIA Sionna-RT toolbox" for one test only. No 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data, and no statement that the model is trained on Sionna-RT.
q2_support: p. 13: "that differ from those used during training" (Fig. 7 varies antennas M and OFDM symbols L around the default of 8 antennas and 16 symbols, p. 12).
q3_support: p. 13: "ZF+FFT [39]: Adopts a zero-forcing precoder" (non-learned) and p. 13: "MMSE+CNN [20]: Employs an MMSE precoder" with a 3D-CNN estimator (learned), compared on position and velocity RMSE in Figs. 6-7.
q4_support: p. 15: "model size (number of parameters) and average execution time" reported in Fig. 13 versus the number of antennas.
q5_support: p. 8: "generate a training dataset consisting of" own simulated samples; no code or data link anywhere, no public dataset or measured data (Sionna-RT is only a cited tool, p. 14).
notes: Area 5: learned precoding, AP mode selection and user association serve sensing and communication together under a sum-rate constraint (p. 5, Eq. 10), so the sensing-alone and localization exclusions do not apply; AP mode and association are above the PHY but are learned jointly with the precoder. q1 is borderline: the main channel is the paper's own model, and the public ray tracer Sionna-RT is used only in the Table III test (p. 15) with no stated training on it; the reviewer may confirm. q2 rests on the explicit statement for antennas and symbols. Heuristic+GAT and Random+GAT are variants of the proposed framework and were not counted as baselines. Version read is the arXiv v2 preprint (2507.06612v2).
